explanation: Kimono simply means 'thing to wear', and it was once the everyday word for clothing in Japan. It is wrapped with the left side over the right.

claims.text: The kimono is a T-shaped Japanese robe tied with a sash called an obi.
The hanbok (Korean), the cheongsam (Chinese) and the kaftan are not Japanese garments tied with an obi.
Kimono means 'thing to wear' in Japanese.
Kimono was once the general Japanese word for clothing.
A kimono is worn with the left side wrapped over the right.
